memory_candidates.content: sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write derives its 'on disk' set from `git ls-files`, not a raw filesystem walk. A newly-created test script must be `git add`-staged BEFORE running the sync, or it silently does not appear as a missing entry to add.

Pattern for extending an existing two-call curl-stub-on-PATH test technique (CURL_STUB_CODE_1/_2 fallback to unsuffixed) to an arbitrary-length N-call sequence: use bash indirect variable expansion (`${!varname}`) inside the stub to look up CURL_STUB_CODE_<call_index> dynamically, still falling back to the unsuffixed var and then a hardcoded default. Avoids hand-writing a fixed number of tiers.

A sapience-extension shell script that unconditionally sources ${SCRIPT_DIR}/lib/common.sh cannot be invoked directly from the source store pre-deploy, since sapience itself carries no scripts/lib/ of its own (it is flattened into .claude/scripts/lib/ only post-deploy). A regression suite for such a script must build a scratch deployed-tree-shaped fixture (<scratch>/.claude/scripts/{script,lib/common.sh}) rather than invoking the source-store copy directly.

sapience_notes.subject: sapience_upkeep.py wire_hooks() REQUIRED set
sapience_notes.value: On this machine, ~/.sapience/sapience_upkeep.py's REQUIRED constant is the string 'ebr' (effect/briefing/receipt), and wire_hooks() unconditionally re-adds three hooks -- SessionStart 'python3 mp --briefing-text', SessionEnd 'python3 mp --receipt', Stop 'python3 mp --effect-line' -- to $HOME/.claude/settings.json on every auto_update/update --wire pass, UNLESS hooks_opted_out() is true (env SAPIENCE_NO_HOOKS == '1', or config.json's 'hooks' key is false). This recurs regardless of any individual repository's own extension activation state.

sapience_notes.subject: sapience_capture.py capture/activation coupling
sapience_notes.value: Transcript capture extraction is gated by a SEPARATE opt-in list from extension activation: ~/.sapience/config.json's capture.projects[].enabled, matched by longest path_prefix (sapience_capture.py's for_cwd()/match_project(), using _under(): cwd == prefix or cwd.startswith(prefix.rstrip('/') + '/')). Measured live: BimodalLogic and Sapience/sf1-engine both have the sapience extension active but capture disabled/absent, while nvim/.dotfiles/abood/sapience-app have both active and capture enabled -- the two lists happen to be a subset relationship today but nothing enforces it in either direction.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-sapience-context-scoping.sh single-run reliability
sapience_notes.value: A single POST /v1/cli/context real-vs-sentinel project comparison is measurably unreliable: three consecutive runs on this machine returned RESIDUAL_LIFTED once and RESIDUAL_HOLDS twice. A live --repeat 3 run during this task's implementation reproduced that same instability as a genuine 2-vs-1 tally, confirming the instability is a property of the live endpoint (likely server-side per-session repeat-suppression interacting with session-id timing), not a flaw in the probe script itself.

sapience_notes.subject: ~/Projects/abood sapience extension merge state
sapience_notes.value: ~/Projects/abood's .claude-extensions.json records extensions.sapience.status == 'active' but merged_sections.settings carries only 'permissions', no 'hooks' key -- a load that predates this extension's hooks fragment and was never re-merged. This is a ledger-recorded cause distinct from (and can co-occur with) a deployed-file grant/hook-count symptom; both are worth checking independently rather than treating one as redundant with the other.

sapience_notes.subject: sync-manifest-scripts.sh git-tracking dependency
sapience_notes.value: sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write derives each extension's 'on disk' script set from `git ls-files <ext>/scripts`, not a raw filesystem walk. A newly-authored script must be `git add`-staged (not necessarily committed) before the sync will detect it as a missing provides.scripts entry -- an untracked new file is invisible to it.
